idea: Cream paper, one ink colour for every line and all body text, flat fills with one hard cel shadow tone. Colour is saved for meaning: stats, statuses, tribes.

colours.name: Paper
colours.use: Page and screen background (light use). Dark use: the text colour on Ink panels.

colours.name: Card
colours.use: Card faces, rules-text boxes, buttons' light fill; light text on coloured fills.

colours.name: Shade
colours.use: The one flat cel shadow for paper: empty slots, the board clearing, panel insets.

colours.name: Ink
colours.use: Every outline, body text, numerals on light badges. Dark use: background of the combat log and dark panels.

colours.name: Ink Soft
colours.use: Secondary text, slot labels, the eliminated player.

colours.name: Mustard
colours.use: Attack badge (ink numerals), a plain round disc. Also the Hive tribe chip. Round 2: a shade deeper and more orange, away from gold.

colours.name: Berry
colours.use: Health badge (card numerals), player health, damage numbers, negative changes.

colours.name: Gilt
colours.use: Gold coins (milled edge), the golden-unit frame, the Tier up button. Round 2: paler lemon, away from the attack mustard.

colours.name: Moss
colours.use: Positive changes, the End turn button, the Hedgerow folk tribe.

colours.name: Heather
colours.use: Nightshade status and keyword, the Fairies tribe, the next-opponent marker.

colours.name: Sky
colours.use: Freeze: the frozen shop card wash, the Freeze button. Also the Birds tribe chip.

colours.name: Peat
colours.use: Bog folk tribe; wooden details (the shop stall rail).

colours.name: Rust
colours.use: Great beasts tribe; the attacker's arrow in combat.

colours.name: Pine
colours.use: Hunters tribe; the enemy side of the combat board.

colours.name: Bramble
colours.use: Ripe blackberries on the board's bramble border (no text).

contrast_checks_wcag._method: WCAG 2.1 relative luminance; AA body text needs 4.5:1.
contrast_checks_wcag._result: Every pair used for text passes AA (4.5:1).

fonts.body: Nunito (Google Fonts), 600-900; stat numerals in Nunito 900
